standard-dialogue-after-royal-trouble.player: Just wondering if you were still here.

standard-dialogue-after-royal-trouble.npc: I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!

during-royal-trouble.player: What are you doing down in these caves?

during-royal-trouble.npc: I'm waiting to work on the excavations...
...though I don't really want to start digging again.

during-royal-trouble.player: Why not? I thought digging was something dwarves were good at.

during-royal-trouble.npc: Not with monsters like that one in those caves.
It had huge teeth and flaming red eyes, and was almost the size of the tunnel!
Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
In that case, could you go and deal with that monster?
I don't want to have to face it again if it attacks the town.

options.text: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!

steps.player: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!

steps.npc: You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course.
There's a crack in the wall where the others are digging, but the rocks are loose, and can fall on you if you're not careful.
I can give you a mining prop to keep them from falling, if you give me a minute to find it...

steps.player: Okay, so all I have to do is get through that wall?

steps.npc: No, after that the only way you can get further is climbing up onto a high ledge, then crawling through a tunnel.
But the walls are slippery...
...and I think I might have broken the lift when I fell off it on my way back.
You'll probably need to fix the lift - I doubt you'd be able to climb.

steps.player: And the monster's behind that tunnel?

steps.npc: Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
There's some rope and some planks near the broken lift - those would probably come in handy.
Ah, here's that mining prop. I knew I had it somewhere.
Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.

options.text: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.

steps.player: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.

steps.npc: That's what I thought, until I saw the sheer size of it. This thing probably MADE the tunnels!

steps.player: And you're sending me in to deal with it alone?

steps.npc: I've heard stories from the Miscellanians. If you're the Regent, you must be quite a strong hero.
So what are you worried about? You probably eat monsters like that for breakfast!

steps.player: I wouldn't put it quite like that...
But I'll help you after all. Now, how do I find this monster?
